kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننفتح (form VII)
# نَنْفَتِحُ (nanfatiḥu) /nan.fa.ti.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
# نَنْفَتِحَ (nanfatiḥa) /nan.fa.ti.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
# نَنْفَتِحْ (nanfatiḥ) /nan.fa.tiħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
